desc: Derive the fixed-center retained-vertex formula: \(1+x+xy=1+x(y+1)\), where eligible branches have capacity at least \(y\).
Establish that a branch’s usable leaf capacity is \(\deg(b)-1\), since all nonselected incident vertices may be deleted.
Fix the degree-array indexing runtime error and validate the per-center sorted-neighbor-capacity scan on samples and edge cases.
